Production Infrastructure Report: Evaluating Hierarchical Agent Memory at Scale.
Engineering evaluation validates that hierarchical memory indexing reduces retrieval latency across production agent clusters.
We observe a 35 to 40 percent latency reduction under sustained query load, confirming academic benchmark findings.
However, index rebalancing introduces a 5 percent write-amplification overhead during continuous trace ingestion.
Overall system throughput improved significantly when cache invalidation thresholds were tuned for read-heavy workloads.
